title: Endpoint Protection (EDR / XDR)
shortDescription: Autonomous protection and anti-tamper shielding for all laptops, servers and edge nodes.
fullDescription: Next-generation endpoint detection and response (EDR/XDR) engineered for distributed enterprise workforces. Lightweight kernel telemetry operates silently without CPU degradation while blocking fileless scripts, memory exploits, and credential theft attempts.
features: Offline Heuristic Engine for Detached Operations
seoTitle: Autonomous Endpoint Detection & Response (EDR) | SPECTRE DEFEND
seoDescription: Next-gen endpoint defense with hardware-rooted tamper protection, memory shielding, and autonomous quarantine.
whatIs: SPECTRE DEFEND Endpoint Protection (EDR / XDR) is an ultra-lightweight endpoint agent providing real-time kernel memory defense, fileless malware neutralization, and autonomous device quarantine across Windows, macOS, Linux, and server environments.
howItWorks:
1. Deep Kernel Hooking: Operates unobtrusively at the OS boundary using eBPF and signed drivers.
2. Behavioral Execution Guard: Analyzes in-memory process transitions, DLL injections, and API calls.
3. Autonomous Local Containment: Suspicious processes are instantly isolated even when the device is disconnected from the internet.
4. Telemetry Telemetry Synchronization: Forensics and process trees are uploaded for enterprise-wide correlation.
whyItMatters: Endpoints are the primary point of entry for over 70% of enterprise breaches. SPECTRE DEFEND ensures that even if an employee clicks a sophisticated malicious payload, the threat is blocked before malicious code executes in memory.
whoItIsFor: Distributed remote workforces, mobile executive laptops, critical production Linux servers, and POS terminals.
deliverables: Device Quarantine and Live Remediation Terminal
Live Fleet Inventory and Vulnerable Software Visibility

faqs.question: Will the agent slow down developer laptops or compiled builds?
faqs.answer: No. SPECTRE DEFEND agents consume less than 1% CPU utilization and fewer than 60MB of RAM, engineered specifically with developer tooling exclusions.

faqs.question: What happens if an endpoint gets attacked while offline?
faqs.answer: SPECTRE DEFEND's autonomous heuristic engine operates completely on-device, isolating threats and locking files locally without requiring cloud connectivity.
